_comment: Scans intentionally NOT delegated by /scan:full. key = scan name, value = reason. Enforced by scripts/checks/scan-coverage.js. Keep this SMALL — prefer ADDING a scan to /scan:full over excluding it. An exclusion is a claim that the scan has no go/no-go health signal for a full-system pass.

exclusions.mc-layer-diff: Read-only informational layer diff (exit 0 always, never a gate). It has no pass/fail health signal, so it is not a go/no-go input to /scan:full — run it directly when you want the product-vs-dev-tooling split. Sibling gate scan:mc-ship-coverage IS in /scan:full.
exclusions.turbo-spend: Report-only spend telemetry for a turbo session; the scan body explicitly says it is intentionally separate from /scan:full, so it is run directly when spend diagnostics are needed rather than used as a go/no-go health input.
